description: A cited market benchmark point estimate from caller-supplied typical views, with optional flat-fee or per-1,000-views offer comparison, payout cap and tracking window, or an affiliate-commission-versus-flat-fee comparison from average product price and commission percent (cited click-through and conversion defaults, overridable). No account needed. Uses no creator account data. For Instagram choose reel, feed_post, story_single or story_3frame; use standard for YouTube, TikTok or X. Optional add-ons (paid usage for 7, 14, 30, 60 or 90 days, whitelisting / Spark Ads / partnership ads, cross-platform syndication, category exclusivity) come back as cited line items with a total and a line the creator can send. Choose deal_type=series and episode_count=2–20 for equal-format episodes. Extra production is an explicit USD budget per episode, never an assumed premium. This is a market ballpark, not a personalized creator rate.

ad_access.description: Ads run from the creator's handle (whitelisting, TikTok Spark Ads, Instagram partnership ads) for the paid_usage_days window.
ad_access.title: Ad Access

avg_product_price_usd.description: Average order value in USD for an affiliate-versus-flat-fee comparison.
avg_product_price_usd.title: Avg Product Price Usd

click_through_pct.description: Percent of views that click the product link. Default 1 (range 0.5-2).
click_through_pct.title: Click Through Pct

commission_pct.description: Affiliate commission percent. Business Insider (2026-11-18) reports Amazon 1-4, Shein 2, Halara 10, Lowe's 8-25.
commission_pct.title: Commission Pct

conversion_pct.description: Percent of link clicks that buy. Default 1.5.
conversion_pct.title: Conversion Pct

exclusivity_breadth.description: narrow: direct competitors only; broad: a whole product category.
exclusivity_breadth.title: Exclusivity Breadth

paid_usage_days.description: Days the brand may run the content as paid ads.
paid_usage_days.title: Paid Usage Days

rate_per_1000_views_usd.description: Offered USD per 1,000 eligible verified views.
rate_per_1000_views_usd.title: Rate Per 1000 Views Usd

syndication_platforms.description: Additional platforms the same deliverable is posted on.
syndication_platforms.title: Syndication Platforms

tracking_window_days.description: Typical views must be views within this window; no decay is inferred.
tracking_window_days.title: Tracking Window Days

name: estimate_market_sponsorship_rate

disclaimer.default: Estimated commission for one post, not guaranteed earnings. Programs pay only on qualifying purchases inside their attribution window, reverse returns, and set rates by product category. Compare against the flat-fee benchmark above, which is also an estimate.
disclaimer.title: Disclaimer

disclaimer.default: Add-ons are cited percentages of the market base, not personalized rates. Confirm the exact rights, windows and platforms in the contract.
disclaimer.title: Disclaimer

production_note.default: Creator-supplied extra production budget, per episode × episode count. Normal creator scripting/shooting is already in the creator fee.
production_note.title: Production Note

disclaimer.default: Estimated gross payout, not guaranteed earnings. Typical views must represent eligible verified views within the stated tracking window. No view-decay adjustment is modeled. Confirm verification rules, rights, fees and payment terms. The flat-fee benchmark uses the supplied view count and its cited source horizon; it is not a window-specific market benchmark.
disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
